svg.title: Private-only | Gateway and model connectivity
svg.desc: Gateway and model public access disabled. Private endpoints are in the VNet; the managed services are not.

g.text: Gateway and model public access disabled. Private endpoints are in the VNet; the managed services are not.
A valid key is not enough
Linked zones resolve gateway and model names to private IPs. Custom DNS requires appropriate forwarding.
Final profile: private-only. The private-connectivity file is an intermediate setup stage, not another deployment path.
